description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, a Java class that implements the LogNode interface. The class filters log output to pass only message content, omitting other metadata, intended for simplified on-screen logging.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode filter that passes only message content, ignoring other log metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters the log message and forwards it to the next LogNode without metadata.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
